_doc: Values only the owner can supply (docs/content/OWNER-INPUTS.md lists each one and the pages that need it). A null or empty value renders as a visible [OWNER TO PROVIDE: ...] marker and blocks `build-trust-pages.mjs --publish`. A confirmation stays false until the owner has checked that the statement is true. Owner decision 5 of 2026-10-04 (docs/decisions/OWNER-DECISIONS-2026-10-04.md): the public contact is gettysburginteractivemap@gmail.com only, so every contact key holds that address; the creator text is read verbatim from docs/content/APPROVED-BIO.md.
